dslRule:
<!id: jdt.core.api.migrate.isSystemModule>
<!description: Migrate from provisional JavaModelAccess.isSystemModule() to the final IModuleDescription.isSystemModule() API (Java 9+).
This change reflects the stabilization of the Java module API within JDT Core.>
<!severity: HINT>
org.eclipse.jdt.core.provisional.JavaModelAccess.isSystemModule($module) :: sourceVersionGE(9) && instanceof($module, "org.eclipse.jdt.core.IModuleDescription")
=> $module.isSystemModule()
;;

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
